class LolGetChampionAnalysis: data,_field_diagnostics
class Data: summary,damage_type,strong_counters,weak_counters,runes
class Summary: average_stats
class AverageStats: play,win_rate,pick_rate,ban_rate,tier,rank
class StrongCounter: champion_name,play,win,win_rate
class Runes: primary_page_id,primary_rune_ids,secondary_page_id,secondary_rune_ids,stat_mod_ids,play,win,pick_rate
class FieldDiagnostics: unmatched_fields,hint

LolGetChampionAnalysis(Data(Summary(AverageStats(305981,0.51,0.12,0.04,1,3)),"AP",[StrongCounter("Galio",5020,2791,0.56),StrongCounter("Pantheon",669,373,0.56),StrongCounter("Orianna",7223,3939,0.55)],[StrongCounter("Katarina",7187,3481,0.52),StrongCounter("Vladimir",5108,2514,0.51),StrongCounter("Veigar",4319,2135,0.51)],Runes(8100,[8112,8139,8140,8106],8200,[8210,8226],[5005,5008,5001],137279,69644,0.48)),FieldDiagnostics(["data.trends.version"],"These field names did not match the response and were skipped. Check the names against this tool's field list. Array fields need \"[]\" before the dot (e.g. \"strong_counters[].win\", not \"strong_counters.win\"); nesting uses \".\", and names are case-sensitive. To get the full response instead, send an empty array."))
